items.title: Sleep Device Maker ResMed Gets an Upgrade. Analysts See a Lot to Like.
items.summary: Sleep device maker  ResMed  rose Tuesday after the stock notched an upgrade and price target increase on Wall Street.  RBC Capital analysts boosted the stock’s rating to Outperform from Sector Perform on Tuesday, while lifting the price target to $262 from $244, citing growing demand for sleep apnea devices.  The firm said that  ResMed  a top provider of devices for respiratory care and obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), is poised to gain market share as global awareness of the condition grows.

items.title: Is Margin Pressure From Rising Costs Altering The Investment Case For ResMed (RMD)?
items.summary: Earlier this year, ResMed reported quarterly results showing revenue of US$1.46 billion, up 8.6% year on year, with adjusted earnings per share ahead of expectations but accompanied by operating margin pressure from higher R&D and supply chain costs. Although the wider patient monitoring sector generally outperformed expectations, ResMed delivered the weakest revenue surprise and slowest growth among peers, raising questions about how rising expenses could affect its profitability...
